# Chronology of brain

This appendix is the engineering timeline the book's historical threads are drawn from. It is generated from the repository's own history: for every month, the number of commits, the crates that first appeared (dated by their earliest name when they were later renamed, and linked to the chapters that explain them) and the engineering findings that were written down. Dates are author dates; the history is kept linear by rebasing, which preserves them.

The chapters teach in the order a reader needs the ideas. This page shows the order in which brain actually needed them, which is often very different: the engine began with a mixture-of-experts language model and a GPU kernel compiler, and only later grew the toy models a beginner would start with.

Findings recorded this month:

- knowledge #1: A gate that never runs is worse than no gate <!-- perf-number: dated historical finding -->
- knowledge #2: Cosine is scale-invariant, so it cannot see a dropped scale factor <!-- perf-number: dated historical finding -->
- knowledge #3: Finite differences gate the backward against whatever forward is emitted <!-- perf-number: dated historical finding -->
- knowledge #4: Degenerate test dims hide whole bug classes <!-- perf-number: dated historical finding -->
- knowledge #5: Run every gradcheck on BOTH backends <!-- perf-number: dated historical finding -->
- knowledge #6: Timing without `poll_wait()` measures the host <!-- perf-number: dated historical finding -->
- knowledge #7: Storage bindings must respect the 256-byte alignment <!-- perf-number: dated historical finding -->
- knowledge #8: "Unused" kernel constants are usually an unwired fast path <!-- perf-number: dated historical finding -->
- knowledge #9: Preprocessing must be shared, not described as shared <!-- perf-number: dated historical finding -->
- knowledge #10: Normalisation conventions are asymmetric and silent <!-- perf-number: dated historical finding -->
- knowledge #11: Test RNGs are code too <!-- perf-number: dated historical finding -->
- knowledge #12: An orphaned `///` mis-documents its neighbour <!-- perf-number: dated historical finding -->
- knowledge #13: Kernel indices are per-crate, so one `Gpu` is not interchangeable <!-- perf-number: dated historical finding -->
- knowledge #14: Fit the card by lifetime, not by hope <!-- perf-number: dated historical finding -->
- knowledge #15: A kernel-selection GUARD can be the bottleneck <!-- perf-number: dated historical finding -->
- knowledge #16: A config default must mirror the REFERENCE's default, not "off" <!-- perf-number: dated historical finding -->
- knowledge #17: `matmul_reg3` supersedes `matmul_reg2` - everywhere <!-- perf-number: dated historical finding -->
- knowledge #18: A constant tuned on the toy fixture can be orders out on the real model <!-- perf-number: dated historical finding -->
- knowledge #19: Registration split across N lists is a defect waiting for its turn <!-- perf-number: dated historical finding -->
- knowledge #20: A fallback path is a path - measure it too <!-- perf-number: dated historical finding -->
- knowledge #21: The per-kernel table is an upper bound - the whole pass is the truth <!-- perf-number: dated historical finding -->
- knowledge #22: Check disk headroom before a wide build <!-- perf-number: dated historical finding -->
- knowledge #23: A training-time config field the checkpoint doesn't persist makes the whole feature a no-op <!-- perf-number: dated historical finding -->
- knowledge #24: A benchmark that measures a path no request takes is a healthy number about the wrong thing <!-- perf-number: dated historical finding -->
- knowledge #25: "Batched prefill" that batches the readback, not the dispatch is not batched <!-- perf-number: dated historical finding -->
- knowledge #26: A barrier kernel on `backend-cpu` corrupts memory; it does not refuse <!-- perf-number: dated historical finding -->
- knowledge #27: A "% of peak" divided by a hardcoded peak is not a measurement <!-- perf-number: dated historical finding -->
- knowledge #28: A partial FLOP numerator over a full denominator under-reports in silence <!-- perf-number: dated historical finding -->
- knowledge #29: `make generate/kernels/registry` had been broken since the script moved <!-- perf-number: dated historical finding -->
- knowledge #30: Two of three backends never implemented `stats()`, and a caller papered over it <!-- perf-number: dated historical finding -->
- knowledge #31: Timing a kernel by host wall-clock around a drained slice is not a measurement <!-- perf-number: dated historical finding -->
- knowledge #32: A profiler that drives the graph wrong measures a graph that does nothing <!-- perf-number: dated historical finding -->
- knowledge #33: A checker that cannot tell code from prose fails on the best-documented file <!-- perf-number: dated historical finding -->
- knowledge #34: A memory saving is not measured by anything unless someone measures it <!-- perf-number: dated historical finding -->
- knowledge #35: The "2x resident overhead" was real, but it was wgpu's, not the hardware's <!-- perf-number: dated historical finding -->
- knowledge #35b: A `const` bump without its array literal is a silent out-of-bounds write <!-- perf-number: dated historical finding -->
- knowledge #35c: The softmax top-k router's cap outlived its own bug-class writeup <!-- perf-number: dated historical finding -->
- knowledge #36: `testdata/`'s "restorable from a mirror" claim needs auditing against a real machine, not assumed from the script <!-- perf-number: dated historical finding -->
- knowledge #37: A roofline probe calibrated for GPU throughput reads as a hang on the CPU backend <!-- perf-number: dated historical finding -->
- knowledge #38: Two unrelated unbounded waits, not one bug, were behind "the GPU hangs" <!-- perf-number: dated historical finding -->
- knowledge #39: A `write_*` call with no matching read on that code path is a silent no-op, not a bug the type system catches <!-- perf-number: dated historical finding -->
- knowledge #40: A tiny gradcheck config can numerically starve a normalization op, producing a hollow - but *passing* - gradcheck <!-- perf-number: dated historical finding -->
- knowledge #41: A kernel's uniform offset parameter usually offsets only ONE named side - check which before reusing it in the other direction <!-- perf-number: dated historical finding -->
- knowledge #42: Streaming through mmap fixes the peak but not the sum, and a checkpoint's index filename is a naming convention, not a guarantee <!-- perf-number: dated historical finding -->
- knowledge #43: A config field that is parsed but never read is a silent architecture gap, and it can affect more than one caller at once <!-- perf-number: dated historical finding -->
- knowledge #44: Destroying the last Vulkan instance can permanently blind a process to its own GPUs <!-- perf-number: dated historical finding -->
- knowledge #45: A stage absent from the timing struct is absent from every conclusion <!-- perf-number: dated historical finding -->
- knowledge #46: A bench with a warm page cache measures the CPU where the real run measures the disk <!-- perf-number: dated historical finding -->
- knowledge #47: A tap measured downstream of a normalization cannot gate a scale error upstream of it <!-- perf-number: dated historical finding -->
- knowledge #48: A parity gate built from the pipeline's own simplified positions cannot catch the pipeline getting positions wrong <!-- perf-number: dated historical finding -->
- knowledge #49: A frozen token still has to be TOLD it is frozen - masking the output is only half the mechanism <!-- perf-number: dated historical finding -->
- knowledge #50: A pixel-delta gate with no calibrated threshold passes on decode dither, and "the conditioned clip does not move" turned out to be the request rather than the bug <!-- perf-number: dated historical finding -->
- knowledge #51: Two backends compiling the same WGSL are not running the same code, and only a per-backend roofline can see it <!-- perf-number: dated historical finding -->
- knowledge #52: Vulkan validation layers are one `apt-get download` away, even with no root and none installed <!-- perf-number: dated historical finding -->
- knowledge #53: Cargo resolves the dependency graph once per invocation, so a `Cargo.toml` edited during a long build produces an "unresolved import" for a dependency that IS there <!-- perf-number: dated historical finding -->
- knowledge #54: A hand-maintained "Supported" checkbox is a duplicate of a fact the code already derives, and three of them were wrong in two directions <!-- perf-number: dated historical finding -->
- knowledge #55: `push_step` past a reverse-mode tape is a silent ZERO gradient, and the SDXL UNet had 200 of them <!-- perf-number: dated historical finding -->
- knowledge #56: `mse_value` writes one term PER ELEMENT for the host to sum, and a 1-element buffer makes the loss silently mean "element 0" <!-- perf-number: dated historical finding -->
- knowledge #57: `0` is not a null pipeline index - an unused kernel slot must hold a sentinel, and only `backend-cpu` makes that a silent corruption <!-- perf-number: dated historical finding -->
- knowledge #58: A measured number in a doc comment outlives the tree it measured, and the next reader will read it as current <!-- perf-number: dated historical finding -->
- knowledge #59: A feature can be complete, gated, benchmarked and unreachable, and only the RUN'S OWN BANNER says which <!-- perf-number: dated historical finding -->
- knowledge #60: A timing span that ends at a scope's closing brace cannot see the DESTRUCTION its own scope causes, and that is where half the cost was <!-- perf-number: dated historical finding -->
- knowledge #61: A device-to-host readback can be dominated by the DESTINATION allocation, and a correctness gate cannot see a performance mechanism at all <!-- perf-number: dated historical finding -->
- knowledge #62: A mapped buffer's pointer is only as aligned as the allocator happened to place it, and `cast_slice` on one holds by luck <!-- perf-number: dated historical finding -->
- knowledge #63: A shared "diffusers VAE" builder is diffusers-NAMED, not diffusers-SHAPED - reusing it for a CompVis-named checkpoint of the identical topology still needs a rename pass <!-- perf-number: dated historical finding -->
- knowledge #64: A GGUF's `general.architecture` is UNTRUSTED input to a family-name match - dispatch it in the same `match` as native checkpoints and any collision routes a file to a loader that cannot read it <!-- perf-number: dated historical finding -->
- knowledge #65: A weight scale that spans the whole reduction axis is one outlier away from destroying the row - group it at the block size of the format you interoperate with <!-- perf-number: dated historical finding -->
- knowledge #66: An overfit gate that reads ONE step of a trajectory is only a gate if the trajectory has converged - above the optimizer's stability threshold it reads the limit cycle's phase <!-- perf-number: dated historical finding -->
- knowledge #67: A decode tape that looks up its projections in the fp32 `ParamStore` cannot serve a quantized build, and a prefill-only int8 test cannot see it <!-- perf-number: dated historical finding -->
- knowledge #68: A byte-cost formula that mirrors a layout is a copy of that layout, and it went stale silently <!-- perf-number: dated historical finding -->
- knowledge #69: Two limits, not one: a weight can be allocatable and still unbindable, and 5 GB is neither <!-- perf-number: dated historical finding -->
